subject: Senescent microglia secrete a protein that drives brain aging
script: From Agewell Brief: Senescent microglia secrete a protein that drives brain aging. A new study reveals a specific mechanism by which aging immune cells in the brain impair neuronal function, linking cellular senescence to cognitive decline. Aging brains lose cognitive sharpness and become vulnerable to neurodegeneration. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
